title: Second-level administrative units (L2)
description: FAO's second-level units (districts, departments, counties), geometry and attributes unchanged from the GAUL 2024 release, with the L1 and country codes and names each unit belongs to. Published twice from the same rows: one whole-world GeoParquet 2.0 file (45,524 rows, 419 MB, the data asset) for anyone who wants a single download, and one file per country under country=<iso3>/ (265 files, the data-<iso3> assets and the partition glob s3://parquetry/gaul/2024/country=*/L2.parquet) for small reads. Both carry a bbox covering and read in place over HTTPS or through the anonymous S3 endpoint s3.geomermaids.com. A PMTiles archive (zoom 3 to 10) draws the layer on a web map. Data (c) FAO 2024, CC BY 4.0, attribution required. FAO has not participated in, sponsored, approved or endorsed this redistribution. The designations employed and the presentation of material in GAUL do not imply the expression of any opinion whatsoever on the part of FAO concerning the legal status of any country, territory, city or area or of its authorities, or concerning the delimitation of its frontiers or boundaries. GAUL is not an authoritative or official representation of subnational boundaries; its purpose is to support the representation of subnational statistics.

providers.name: Geomermaids
providers.description: Converted the FAO shapefiles to GeoParquet, derived the L0 layer, and maintains and hosts this catalog and its data.

partition:keys.name: country
partition:keys.description: The unit's iso3_code: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, plus FAO's pseudo-codes for disputed areas (xAB Abyei, xJK Jammu and Kashmir, xxx). A few codes group several GAUL units, e.g. AUS also holds Ashmore and Cartier Islands. One file per code.

table:columns.name: iso3_code
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country.

table:columns.name: map_code
table:columns.description: FAO map code of the country, as used across FAO statistical products.

table:columns.name: gaul0_code
table:columns.description: GAUL code of the country (level 0). Stable across GAUL releases; the key to join FAO country statistics on.

table:columns.name: gaul0_name
table:columns.description: Name of the country, as FAO writes it.

table:columns.name: gaul1_code
table:columns.description: GAUL code of the first-level unit.

table:columns.name: gaul2_code
table:columns.description: GAUL code of the second-level unit.

table:columns.name: continent
table:columns.description: Continent the unit is on, as FAO assigns it.

table:columns.name: disp_en
table:columns.description: Display name in English, the label FAO uses on maps.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin FLOAT, ymin FLOAT, xmax FLOAT, ymax FLOAT)
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), declared as the GeoParquet covering. Filter on it to prune row groups before touching geometry.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Unit outline as native Parquet GEOMETRY (WKB), OGC:CRS84 lon/lat, MultiPolygon.
